events.headline: Essay misrepresents and fabricates sleep research findings
events.summary: One claim is correctly supported, but the essay includes an unverifiable meta‑analysis statistic and a direct misrepresentation of Okano et al.’s positive correlation between sleep quality and grades. These errors undermine the paper’s credibility.
actions: Delete or replace the fabricated 23% exam‑score claim with accurate data.
Correct the Okano et al. description to reflect the reported positive correlation.
Re‑verify every citation against the original source before final submission.
